title: Protect every preloading route with live permission and authoritative booking scope
description: Stage3 core inventory closure. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Resolve enabled current user and existing pre-loading menu for every list/detail/timeline/create/update/submit/approve/cancel/delete route before reads, counts, number generation or changes. Scope linked documents using explicit BookingId and authoritative booking CustomerId with existing SalespersonDataScopeService. Restricted users must be denied unlinked or missing-source documents lacking authoritative ownership, while legitimately unrestricted users retain historical access. No number-based guesses or new grants.

Validate proposed and stored booking scope before assigning fields or replacing details; denied edits and state transitions preserve original detail/status/audit. Serialize edit/delete/submit/approve/cancel under compatible existing booking/preloading lock order and transaction. Retain ERP353 eligibility and ERP348 downstream cancellation guards. Test actual controllers with SQL own/foreign customer, null/missing source, revoked menu, disabled user, failed edits and two-connection edit/approval races.
